device-daemon._comment: Owns the scrcpy-cli daemon so the agent never runs `daemon start`/`daemon stop` itself -- the device-control skill just issues actions. Brings the daemon up on the first LLM call of a conversation (ALWAYS_START=True in scrcpy_daemon.py; set it False to start only when the transcript shows device work per SIGNALS -- scrcpy-cli|mirror, ui-dump, uiautomator, or an activated device-control skill). Idempotent via a per-conversationId marker, so the ~50 PreInvocations in a session cost one marker check each. A 60s negative cache avoids re-probing when no device is attached. Stop is refcounted by conversationId so a finishing subagent cannot kill a daemon its parent is still using, and a daemon started by hand is never stopped. PreInvocation/Stop only -- a PreToolUse hook on run_command would have to return a decision for every shell command. Requires `scrcpy-cli` on PATH (build core/scrcpy_cli and `npm link`, or `npm install -g` from it). Injected by `pokit init`.

device-guard._comment: Enforces the delegation invariant that orchestrator.md's empty tool list cannot: the session the human is talking to does not drive the device and does not write the spec -- business-analyst does. Denies (for the ROOT session only; a dispatched subagent passes) a run_command invoking a real scrcpy-cli device action (tap/swipe/write/key/app-start/screenshot/ui-dump/...; device-list/daemon status are not gated, they inspect rather than act) and any write under docs/spec/. Root vs. delegate is decided the same way as REAKit's write_guard.py: scanning sibling transcripts for a parent's 'Created the following subagents' record naming this conversationId, directional on purpose so a child's report-back cannot misclassify its own parent. Ported from REAKit (github.com/impeterwayne/REAKit)'s write_guard.py -- the classification mechanism is copied verbatim; only the gate list changed, from source-file suffixes to scrcpy-cli actions and docs/spec/ writes. UNVERIFIED: the real argument key run_command uses for its command line -- every string value in args is scanned instead of guessing one key. Fails open on any error. Escape hatch: `python .agents/hooks/device_guard.py --off` (also --on, --status). Verified: self-tests pass.
